rootDocText: Composes the browser bundle tests: codegen, closed actor bundle, host activation and the closed component factory over one dependency bag.

children.doc:
🧬️ The browser codegen tests: compiler capsule, captured sources, policy snapshots, the async task return lift and the generated manifest.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | createBrowserBundleTests}: a factory over the same `dependencies` bag and `source` as the root, returning its test functions.
children.name: createBrowserCodegenTests
children.fnDoc: Builds the browser codegen test functions over the shared dependency bag.

children.doc:

children.name: createBrowserActorBundleTests
children.fnDoc: Builds the closed browser actor bundle test over the shared dependency bag.

children.doc:

children.name: createBrowserHostActivationTests

children.doc:
